detail.longDescription: Soon, the software industry is going to realise that all the code that was rapidly (and carelessly) generated in pursuit of "100x" productivity has become a liability and the AI that promised to free up everyone has become the core dependency, without which the system just cannot move forward. At that point, we are going to need the "software deslopers" who are just the old software developers, the vibe-less coders, just with a new title that makes them employable once again :) Still holding out hope!
